solution_steps: Set Stronghold the Moving Fortress and activate it immediately (which you can due to the Cathedrals effect).
Now tribute the Trap Monster to summon Catapult Turtle.
First catapult all the gadgets into your opponents LP, then finish him with turtles self-sacrifice.
